FCV Farul Constanța, commonly known as Farul Constanța or simply Farul, is a Romanian professional football club based in Constanța, Constanța County, that competes in the Liga I, the top tier of the Romanian league system. Farul means \"the Lighthouse\" in Romanian, referring to the city's location on the Black Sea coast.
